resumen: Reserva: lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:00, Dr. Andrés Sáez, Arenal Norte

eventos.texto: Good afternoon, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hello, I'd like to see Dr. Requena at Atria Neurological Center, please.
Could I take your full name, and either your DNI or NIE, or the phone number on your file?
Antonio Ruiz Medina, born 3rd of May 1944.
Ficha encontrada: Antonio R. (por fecha de nacimiento y nombre)
El médico pedido está de baja hasta el 30 de septiembre: busca con otro (641 huecos)
Ofrece el lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:00 con el Dr. Andrés Sáez en Arenal Norte

Thank you, Antonio, I have your record here. Dr. Pablo Requena is on leave until the 30th of September. The earliest with another general practice at Arenal Norte is Monday the 21st of September at 8 am with Dr. Andrés Sáez. Would you like that instead?
Oh, all right. Yes, that's fine.
Reserva · lunes 21 de septiembre, 8:00 · Dr. Andrés Sáez · Arenal Norte
That's booked: Monday the 21st of September at 8 am with Dr. Andrés Sáez at Arenal Norte. Is there anything else I can help with?
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
